description: This PHP class 'LeaveRequestCommentDecorator' provides methods for manipulating and decorating 'LeaveRequestComment' entities, including referencing related entities (Employee, User, LeaveRequest) and formatting creation date/time.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDecorator
